source.scope: stable model aliases in the installed Gemini CLI selector

capability_source.scope: Gemini CLI model aliases and selection guidance

fallback_use.availability_scope: alias resolution and account eligibility remain runtime-dependent

reasoning_control.selection_rule: Use an observed thinkingBudget or thinkingLevel only when the current Gemini CLI exposes that exact configurable value; otherwise retain the selected model's default.
reasoning_control.forbidden_inference: Do not convert task-demand labels such as low, moderate, or high into Gemini selector values.

models.official_description: Lets Gemini CLI choose an appropriate available model for the task.
models.selection_guidance: Use when account-specific model resolution is unknown or when CLI-managed routing is preferable.

models.official_description: Gemini CLI alias for complex reasoning tasks; the resolved model depends on availability and preview settings.
models.selection_guidance: Use for difficult, ambiguous, high-consequence, or deeply validated work when the account exposes this tier.

models.official_description: Fast, balanced Gemini CLI alias for most tasks.
models.selection_guidance: Use for ordinary well-scoped implementation, retrieval, transformation, and validation work.

models.official_description: Fastest Gemini CLI alias for simple tasks.
models.selection_guidance: Use for clear, low-risk, repetitive, or lightweight work.
